entries.0513fd955c56bc34: This is a service that supports medical research involving human subjects. From support for participating medical institutions at the start of research, through collection and checking of clinical data and monitoring of research implementation, to statistical analysis of collected data and preparation of result reports, it provides a series of research-related services on a one-stop basis.
entries.056b1168a95dc1e9: A service that provides support for the various documents and materials that arise at each stage of drug development. In addition to quality control (QC) and translation of approval application materials and support for preparing the CTD (the common drug approval application format for Japan, the US and EU3), it widely supports document work incidental to running clinical trials, such as preparing and QC of clinical trial notifications and related materials, sending documents, and printing and managing clinical trial materials.
entries.2bbcb9c6f30e239d: Preparation and management of contract documents on behalf of others
entries.2bead5af220d9151: This is a single segment: the CRO Business. It performs outsourced and support services in the development of pharmaceuticals and medical devices, and operates four services, centered on its safety information management service. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥4,815 million. Each service is mainly provided under outsourcing contracts, and some are also provided under staffing contracts.
entries.5a74c753615cfe18: Listed on the Mothers Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange
entries.6cb973aa3df4f57f: This is the core service. For safety information arising from clinical trials and after the marketing of pharmaceuticals, it assigns case control numbers and enters data in the safety information management database, and prepares draft assessments of whether reporting to the Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA), the regulator, is required, as well as draft reports. It also provides Japanese-English and English-Japanese translation and filing of paper documents.
